title: What Is KYC?
description: Why financial platforms ask for identity verification.
bodyMarkdown:
## What it means
KYC means Know Your Customer. Financial platforms use it to verify identity and reduce fraud, money laundering, and account misuse.

## Beginner reminder
Only submit documents through official app or website channels. Be careful with links sent through chat or social media.

title: What Is Risk Tolerance?
description: A simple way to think about comfort with uncertainty and losses.
bodyMarkdown:
## What it means
Risk tolerance is how much uncertainty and possible loss you can handle without making rushed decisions.

## Beginner reminder
Risk tolerance depends on income stability, goals, timeline, emergency fund, and emotional comfort. It is personal, so this app does not tell you what to buy.

title: Crypto Risk Checklist
description: A safety checklist before studying crypto products.
bodyMarkdown:
## Checklist
- Can you explain what the asset or protocol does?
- Do you understand volatility and liquidity risk?
- Do you know how wallet security works?
- Are there guaranteed-return claims?
- Are you relying only on social media hype?

## Safety reminder
Do not share seed phrases, private keys, passwords, or OTPs.
